title: EMMO: Early Modern Manuscripts Online
notes: EMMO is the Folger Shakespeare Library's IMLS-funded project giving web access to TEI P5 transcriptions, images and metadata of 16th- and 17th-century English manuscripts, with diplomatic/semi-diplomatic/regularized text flavors and a downloadable XML corpus; the site (live 200) documents exactly '100 transcribed documents', matching the harvest origin 'EMMO (Folger), 100 manuscript transcriptions'. Crowdsourced transcription ran on Dromio (transcribe.folger.edu); the IMLS grant concluded, leaving the site a preserved static resource. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Folger Shakespeare Library (project lead Heather Wolfe)
